Class ViewMessageThread

java.lang.Object
guiMessageThread.ViewMessageThread
public class ViewMessageThread extends Object

Title: ViewMessageThread Class.

Description: This page shows the currently logged-in user all private messages exchanged with one other user, ordered chronologically. When a message references a valid Post or Reply, the page also displays a note showing what that message is responding to. This page also supports composing a new message, optionally pre-linked to a Post or Reply selected elsewhere in the application.

Author:
CSE 360 Team

    • displayMessageThread

      public static void displayMessageThread(javafx.stage.Stage ps, User user, String otherUser, int postId, int replyId)

      Method: displayMessageThread(Stage ps, User user, String otherUser, int postId, int replyId)

      Description: The single external entry point for this page when a new outgoing message should be pre-linked to a specific Post or Reply.

      Parameters:
      ps - the primary JavaFX Stage
      user - the currently logged-in User
      otherUser - the other participant in the conversation
      postId - the Post to link to the next outgoing message, or -1 if none
      replyId - the Reply to link to the next outgoing message, or -1 if none
